en.bdb: With one word (sound) the Lord creates the universe and destroyes it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਦੂੰ ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਨ ਓੜਕੁ ਜਾਪਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: tidhoo(n) lakh dhareeaau na oRak jaapadhaa|

en.bdb: From that very Lord myriads of life streams have emerged and there is no end to them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਸਮਾਉ ਨ ਲਹਰਿ ਵਿਆਪਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: lakh brahama(n)dd samaau na lahar viaapadhaa|

en.bdb: Millions of universes subsume in Him but He is uninfluenced by any of them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਚਾਉ ਲਖ ਪਰਤਾਪਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: kar kar vekhai chaau lakh parataapadhaa|

en.bdb: He sees His own activities with great enthusiasm and makes many a man glorious

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਉਣ ਕਰੈ ਅਰਥਾਉ ਵਰ ਨ ਸਰਾਪ ਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: kaun karai arathaau var na saraap dhaa|

en.bdb: Who can decode the mystery and meaning of the principle of His boons and curses?

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਹੈ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਉ ਪੁੰਨ ਨ ਪਾਪ ਦਾ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit_en: lahai na pachhotaau pu(n)n na paap dhaa ||18||

en.bdb: He accepts not only the (mental) repentance of sins and virtues (and accepts the good deeds).
